name: Conditional Antimatroids Satisfy the Factorwise Product Theorem
statement: For finite nonempty binary classes on disjoint coordinates, $A\times B$ has a conditional-antimatroid orientation if and only if both factors do.
proof: Minimal missing patterns of a product lie in a single factor, so $H(A\times B)=H(A)+H(B)$. Products and factors of ample classes are ample, and the zero characterization gives both directions.
